AbstractClassInstantiation.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

AccessModifierPresented.summary:
Class members that rely on PHP's implicit public visibility (methods declared
with no visibility keyword, properties declared with `var`/`static`/`readonly`
only, constants declared with a bare `const`) should spell out their visibility
explicitly so intent is clear to readers.
AccessModifierPresented.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| ANALYZE_INTERFACES | bool | true | When false, interface declarations are not inspected at all. |
| ANALYZE_CONSTANTS | bool | true | When false, class constants are never reported (D3 disabled). |

AeadAuthenticationTagDiscarded.summary: Authenticated encryption requires the generated authentication tag for later verification. Capture and store the tag with the ciphertext.

AeadDecryptionTagLengthUnchecked.summary: Authenticated decryption needs a tag of the expected length. Validate request-supplied tag lengths before calling the decryptor. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.
AeadDecryptionTagLengthUnchecked.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tagLength | int | `16` | Configure the explicit policy evidence described in D1. |

AliasFunctionsUsage.summary:
Several built-in PHP functions exist only as alternative names for another
built-in (`sizeof` for `count`, `join` for `implode`, …), and a few of those
alternative names were deprecated or removed. Calling the canonical function
keeps code consistent and avoids relying on legacy names.

AlterInForeach.summary:
Three related `foreach` value-variable pitfalls:

1. a by-reference value (`as &$v`) that stays alive after the loop, so a later
   write to `$v` silently modifies the last array element;
2. an `unset($v)` right after a loop whose `$v` was *not* a reference (the
   unset is pointless, probably a leftover);
3. (opt-in) writing back through `$array[$key] = …` inside
   `foreach ($array as $key => $value)` where a by-reference value would do.
AlterInForeach.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| SUGGEST_USING_VALUE_BY_REF | bool | false | Enables part C (D7–D8). Parts A and B are always active. |

AmbiguousMethodsCallsInArrayMapping.summary:
When a loop builds a map like `$map[key($x)] = key($x);`, the same call is
evaluated twice per iteration (once for the key, once for the value). Compute
it once into a local variable.

AmbiguousReplacementBackreference.summary: Detect preg_replace with a literal replacement containing a numeric backreference followed immediately by a digit where the parsed larger capture number does not exist but the shorter one does.
AmbiguousReplacementBackreference.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

AppendModeSeekUsedForOverwrite.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

ArgumentUnpackingCanBeUsed.summary:
Since PHP 5.6, `call_user_func_array('fn', $args)` with a literal function
name can be written as a direct call with argument unpacking, `fn(...$args)`,
which is faster and easier to read and analyse.

ArrayChunkInvalidSize.summary: Detect array_chunk with a size proven an integer less than one.
ArrayChunkInvalidSize.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayColumnDuplicateIndexLoss.summary: Using duplicate index values in array_column overwrites earlier rows. Use unique indices or group rows when every value must remain available.

ArrayColumnMissingField.summary: Detect array_column on a literal array of literal rows when at least one row has the requested literal field and at least one lacks it.
ArrayColumnMissingField.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayCombineLengthMismatch.summary: Detect array_combine when both input arrays have statically known, unequal element counts; use PHP array overwrite semantics when counting.
ArrayCombineLengthMismatch.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayCopyRetainsReferences.summary: Copying an array does not detach reference-valued elements. Changing a referenced element through the copy can also change the original array. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ArrayDiffOnNestedArrays.summary: array_diff compares elements through string conversion and cannot distinguish nested arrays correctly. Compare nested values structurally.

ArrayFillNegativeCount.summary: Identify array_fill when num/count argument is a proven negative integer.

ArrayFillSharesObject.summary: Filling an array with one object places the same object in every entry. Construct separate objects when entries must hold independent state. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ArrayFilterDropsZero.summary: Detect builtin array_filter with its callback omitted or explicitly null, when the effective entries of a literal array contain integer zero or string zero and another nonempty scalar value. Later entries replacing the same key determine the effective value.
ArrayFilterDropsZero.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayFlipDuplicateValueLoss.summary: Detect array_flip of a literal array with two statically equal string or integer values after PHP key conversion.
ArrayFlipDuplicateValueLoss.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayFlipInvalidValueType.summary: Detect array_flip of a literal array containing a value proven neither string nor integer.
ArrayFlipInvalidValueType.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayIsListCanBeUsed.summary:
Hand-written "is this array a list?" checks — comparing `array_values($a)`
with `$a`, or `array_keys($a)` with `range(0, count($a) - 1)` — are better
expressed with the built-in `array_is_list($a)`.

ArrayMapMissingCallbackReturn.summary: Detect array_map with a locally defined callback whose reachable normal exits all return no value and whose body evaluates a discarded expression with a non-void result.
ArrayMapMissingCallbackReturn.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayMergeNumericKeyLoss.summary: Detect array_merge with a literal input containing a nonsequential integer key; report the input merge call.
ArrayMergeNumericKeyLoss.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArrayMultisortLengthMismatch.summary: Parallel arrays passed to array_multisort must have equal lengths. Align the records before sorting them together.

ArrayPushMissUse.summary:
Appending a single element with `array_push($list, $item);` costs a function
call; the append operator `$list[] = $item;` does the same faster. Likewise,
`$list[count($list)] = $item;` computes an index that the append operator
would produce anyway (for list-shaped arrays).
ArrayPushMissUse.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| REPORT_EXCESSIVE_COUNT_CALLS | bool | true | Enables part B (`C[count(C)] = …`). |

ArrayRandInvalidCount.summary: Identify array_rand when count is a proven integer below one or greater than the exact cardinality of a known array; empty arrays with omitted count also violate.

ArrayRandKeyUsedAsValue.summary: array_rand returns a key rather than the selected element. Read the element at that key when the consumer requires an array value. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ArrayReduceMissingInitialValue.summary: Detect array_reduce without an initial argument when a local callback passes its accumulator to a builtin requiring an array on the first iteration.
ArrayReduceMissingInitialValue.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ArraySearchUsedAsInArray.summary:
`array_search()` returns a key (which may be `0` or `''`) or `false`. When its
result is only used as a yes/no answer, `in_array()` expresses the intent
directly and avoids the classic "key 0 is falsy" trap. Comparing its result
with `true` is always pointless, since the function never returns `true`.

ArraySliceDiscardsRequiredKeys.summary: Array slicing normally renumbers numeric keys. Preserve keys when later code reads the original numeric positions. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ArraySpliceDiscardsReplacementKeys.summary: Array splicing discards the keys supplied by its replacement array. Insert map entries with an operation that preserves their keys. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ArrayUnionDropsRightValues.summary: Array union keeps left-hand values when keys collide. Use merging when both lists must contribute their values. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ArrayUniqueCanBeUsed.summary:
Counting occurrences with `array_count_values()` just to take the keys or the
number of keys is an indirect way of deduplicating. Since PHP 7.2
`array_unique()` is fast and says what is meant: `array_values(array_unique($a))`
or `count(array_unique($a))`.

ArrayUniqueOnNonStringableObjects.summary: Default array_unique comparison needs string representations. Use an explicit identity or key when objects cannot be converted to strings.

ArrayWalkCallbackReturnIgnored.summary: array_walk ignores callback return values. Use array_map to build transformed values, or update elements through a reference parameter.

ArrowFunctionCapturedCounter.summary: Detect an arrow function updating a captured scalar counter when the same callable is invoked at least twice without reassignment.
ArrowFunctionCapturedCounter.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

AssertionContainsRequiredSideEffect.summary: Identify an assert call containing an assignment to a previously undefined local when a reachable subsequent read requires that local before any unconditional assignment. Restrict to straight-line scope; exclude parameters, global/static locals, references, any earlier local definition or prior read. Do not guess about other side effects.

AsyncSignalSetterReturnMisread.summary: Query the signal state after changing it.

AttributeTargetMismatch.summary: Use the attribute on a permitted target.
AttributeTargetMismatch.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

AuthenticationCookieAllowsScriptAccess.summary: An authentication cookie without HttpOnly is available to scripts. Enable HttpOnly when the configured authentication policy requires it. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.
AuthenticationCookieAllowsScriptAccess.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| authenticationCookies | list | `["auth_token"]` | Configure the explicit policy evidence described in D1. |

AutoloadingIssues.summary:
PSR-0/PSR-4 autoloaders locate a class by its name, so a file that declares a
single class whose name does not match the file name will not be found by the
autoloader. Point at the class name when file and class names disagree.

BacktickOperatorUsage.summary:
The backtick operator runs a shell command just like `shell_exec()`, but it
is easy to overlook when reading code and security scanners often miss it.
Calling `shell_exec()` explicitly makes command execution visible.

BadExceptionsProcessing.summary:
Two smells around `try`/`catch`: a `try` block that wraps too many statements
(hard to tell which one is expected to throw), and a `catch` clause that
binds the exception to a variable but never looks at it (the error is
swallowed or its cause is lost).

Base64ValidationWithoutStrictMode.summary: Non-strict base64 decoding can discard invalid characters. Enable strict mode when the result is being used to validate an encoding.

BasicAuthenticationOverPlainHttp.summary: Basic authentication credentials sent over plain HTTP are exposed in transit. Use HTTPS for the configured request.

BcMathExponentNotation.summary: Use ordinary decimal notation for BCMath operands.
BcMathExponentNotation.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

BcMathFloatOperand.summary: Supply decimal strings before BCMath arithmetic. This inspection is disabled by default; enabling it selects the stated policy.
BcMathFloatOperand.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

BcMathScaleDiscardsRequiredFraction.summary: Retain fractional digits in decimal arithmetic. This inspection is disabled by default; enabling it selects the stated policy.
BcMathScaleDiscardsRequiredFraction.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

BcryptPasswordTruncation.summary: bcrypt supports only a limited password byte length. Apply an explicit supported password-length policy before hashing.

BufferedWriteFlushedAfterUnlock.summary: Identify fflush after proven fwrite on the same exclusively locked stream when LOCK_UN occurs between write and flush and no intervening flush or close occurred.

ByteLengthUsedAsCharacterCount.summary: Detect strlen of a literal non-ASCII valid UTF-8 string under an explicitly enabled Unicode character-count contract.
ByteLengthUsedAsCharacterCount.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

BytePaddingUsedForUnicodeWidth.summary: Detect str_pad with literal non-ASCII valid UTF-8 input under an explicitly enabled character-width contract.
BytePaddingUsedForUnicodeWidth.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

CallableMethodValidity.summary:
`is_callable()` on a method callback that names a non-public method, or a
non-static method without an object, describes a callback that cannot really
be invoked from the outside (or will break when invoked statically). Flag the
argument so the method's visibility/static-ness gets fixed.

CallableParameterUseCaseInTypeContext.summary:
A parameter's declared/documented type is a contract. Testing it with an
`is_*()` function that can never succeed (or never fail) for that type is dead
logic, and re-assigning the parameter a value of an unrelated type breaks the
contract for every later reader of the variable.

CallbackRequiredArgumentMismatch.summary: Detect array_map with N supplied input arrays and a resolved callback requiring more than N positional parameters.
CallbackRequiredArgumentMismatch.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

CascadeStringReplacement.summary:
`str_replace()` accepts arrays of searches and replacements and applies them
in order, so several consecutive replacements on the same subject — written
as back-to-back assignments or as nested calls — can be one call. Also, a
search array whose items are all the same string literal can be that string.
CascadeStringReplacement.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| USE_SHORT_ARRAYS_SYNTAX | bool | false | Array syntax for arrays in the rebuilt call (F5): `[...]` when true, `array(...)` when false. Detection unaffected. Upstream fixtures run with `true`. |

CascadingDirnameCalls.summary:
Since PHP 7.0 `dirname()` accepts a second "levels" argument, so a chain of
nested `dirname()` calls can be collapsed into a single call with the summed
level count: fewer calls, easier to read.

CaseInsensitiveStringFunctionsMissUse.summary:
Case-insensitive search functions (`stripos`, `strripos`, `stristr`) do extra
case-folding work. When the needle has no letters at all (e.g. `'/'`, `'::'`,
`'42'`), case does not matter and the plain case-sensitive counterpart gives
the same result faster.

CatchCannotHandleKnownThrowable.summary: Identify a catch clause when its directly enclosing try consists of one explicit throw of a resolved Error subtype and every catch type excludes that subtype; exclude finally and calls that can throw another type.

CatchVariableOverwritesLocal.summary: A catch variable shares its surrounding local scope. Use a different name when the previous local value is needed after exception handling. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ClassConstantCanBeUsed.summary:
Since PHP 5.5 a class name can be obtained with `Name::class`. Writing class
names as string literals hides them from refactoring tools and static
analysis, and `get_called_class()` / `get_parent_class()` without arguments
have constant-expression equivalents (`static::class`, `parent::class`).
ClassConstantCanBeUsed.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IMPORT_CLASSES_ON_QF` | bool | true | Fix may add a `use` import for namespaced classes and reference them by short name. |
| `USE_RELATIVE_QF` | bool | false | When importing is otherwise possible, a class below the file's (first) namespace is written as a namespace-relative name instead of being imported. |
| `LOOK_ROOT_NS_UP` | bool | false | Also consider unqualified strings (no backslash), looked up as root-namespace classes (`'Thing'` → `\Thing`). |

Upstream fixtures run with `IMPORT_CLASSES_ON_QF=true, USE_RELATIVE_QF=true,
LOOK_ROOT_NS_UP=true`, except the no-namespace configuration case
(`true, false, false`). Some upstream cases rely on classes declared in a
companion file (project index).

ClassConstantUsageCorrectness.summary:
`Foo::class` is resolved at compile time from the name *as written*, so a
class name typed with the wrong letter case (or imported with the wrong case)
produces a string that differs from the real class name. That string then
breaks case-sensitive comparisons, array keys, container ids and autoloaders
on case-sensitive file systems.

ClassMethodNameMatchesFieldName.summary:
When a method and a property share a name, `$obj->name()` and
`($obj->name)()` mean different things. This is especially confusing when the
property holds a callable, and when the property's type is unknown the reader
cannot tell which one is meant.

ClassMockingCorrectness.summary:
Test doubles are generated by subclassing: final classes cannot be mocked,
traits and abstract classes need dedicated factory methods, and mocks built
with the constructor enabled need the constructor's required arguments.
Point at the class argument of PHPUnit / Prophecy mocking calls (and PhpSpec
collaborator type hints) that will fail at runtime.

ClassOverridesFieldOfSuperClass.summary:
Re-declaring a property that an ancestor already declares is usually
accidental: for protected/public properties it merely duplicates the
declaration (often with a diverging default), and for an ancestor's private
property it creates a second, unrelated property with the same name.
ClassOverridesFieldOfSuperClass.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REPORT_PRIVATE_REDEFINITION` | bool | true | Also report re-declarations of an ancestor's (or ancestor trait's) private property (D5). |

ClassReImplementsParentInterface.summary:
Listing an interface in `implements` when the parent class already implements
it (directly or through its own ancestors) is redundant noise. Remove the
entry.

ClosureCapturedValueWrite.summary: Detect a closure writing a scalar captured by value when that closure is invoked and the outer variable is subsequently read without an intervening assignment.
ClosureCapturedValueWrite.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

CodePointSliceSplitsGrapheme.summary: A visible character can contain several Unicode code points. Slice display text at grapheme boundaries to preserve the complete character. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

CollatorSortDiscardsRequiredKeys.summary: Preserve keys during collation sorting. Disabled by default. Explicit enablement establishes the policy described in Detection; names, comments and example labels never establish intent.

CompactArguments.summary:
`compact('name')` silently skips (or, since PHP 7.3, warns about) variables
that do not exist at that point. A name that never appeared earlier in the
function is usually a typo or a variable assigned too late.

CompactCanBeUsed.summary:
An array literal whose every entry maps a string key to the variable of the
same name (`['id' => $id, 'tag' => $tag]`) can be written as
`compact('id', 'tag')`, which avoids repeating each name twice.

ComparisonOperandsOrder.summary:
Enforces one consistent operand order for equality comparisons against a
literal/constant: with the project-wide comparison style set to *yoda*, the
literal must come first (`10 === $n`); with the *regular* style (default), the
variable part must come first (`$n === 10`).
ComparisonOperandsOrder.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| (none) | | | Driven by the global comparison style setting (`comparisonStyle`: `regular` default, or `yoda`). |

CompressionDecoderFormatMismatch.summary: Match the decoder to the compression format.

CompressionLevelOutsideSupportedRange.summary: Use a supported compression level. Enabled by default; require positive semantic or local-flow proof.

ConflictingContentLengthHeaders.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

ConnectTimeoutAssumedToBoundReads.summary: Set a separate timeout for stream reads. This opt-in rule applies the policy described in Detection.

ConstantCanBeUsed.summary:
Some function calls only return a value that PHP already exposes as a
constant (`PHP_VERSION`, `PHP_SAPI`, `M_PI`, …), and comparisons of
`PHP_VERSION` via `version_compare()` or OS sniffing on `PHP_OS` have cheaper,
clearer constant-based equivalents (`PHP_VERSION_ID`, `PHP_OS_FAMILY`).

ContentDispositionFilenameNeedsQuoting.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

ContentEncodingBodyMismatch.summary: Encode the body using the declared content coding.
ContentEncodingBodyMismatch.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

ContentLengthKnownBodyMismatch.summary: Match Content-Length to the emitted bytes.
ContentLengthKnownBodyMismatch.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

ContentLengthUsesCharacterCount.summary: Detect Content-Length built from mb_strlen/grapheme_strlen of the exact response body later emitted without transformation.
ContentLengthUsesCharacterCount.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ContentRangeLengthMismatch.summary: Match the body to the inclusive byte range.
ContentRangeLengthMismatch.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

CookieDeletionScopeMismatch.summary: Cookie deletion must target the same path and domain as creation. Use the original scope when expiring the cookie.

CopyFailureReportedAsSuccess.summary: Identify discarded copy call in a function whose next reachable statement is unconditional return true; exclude throws, checks and propagated return copy.

CorsOriginListInvalid.summary: Send one allowed origin in the CORS header.
CorsOriginListInvalid.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

CorsSubdomainWildcardInvalid.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

CredentialedCorsUsesWildcardOrigin.summary: Browsers reject a wildcard CORS origin for credentialed requests. Return an explicit allowed origin instead.

CryptographicallySecureAlgorithms.summary:
Some cipher/hash selector constants of mcrypt, OpenSSL and `crypt()` pick
algorithms that are broken or weak (DES, 3DES, RC2, RC4, MD5) or that are
commonly mistaken for AES (Rijndael with 192/256-bit blocks). Point at each
use so a stronger algorithm can be chosen.

CryptographicallySecureRandomness.summary:
`openssl_random_pseudo_bytes()` and `mcrypt_create_iv()` can silently fall
back to weak sources or fail (returning `false`) and their strength depends on
optional arguments. Point out missing strength arguments, unverified results
and weak sources, and suggest `random_bytes()` on PHP 7+.

CsvBlankRecordShapeMismatch.summary: Recognize a blank CSV record as a null field.
CsvBlankRecordShapeMismatch.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

CsvDelimiterInvalidByteLength.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

CsvEscapeDefaultDependency.summary: Pass the CSV escape character explicitly.
CsvEscapeDefaultDependency.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

CsvReadLengthSplitsKnownRecord.summary: Identify fgetcsv whose positive integer length is less than a fully known next physical record and splits outside a quoted field. Require local data:// source provenance and full dialect understanding; unknown files exclude.

CtypeIntegerInterpretedAsCharacterCode.summary: An integer ctype argument can be interpreted as a character code. Pass a string when testing the characters of its decimal representation. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

CurlCustomGetRetainsPostBody.summary: A custom GET method does not clear an already configured request body. Remove the body when switching to a bodyless GET request. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

CurlCustomHeadWithoutNoBody.summary: Setting a custom HEAD method does not configure all of cURL's transfer behavior. Use the no-body option for a HEAD transfer.

CurlExplicitInfiniteTimeout.summary: An explicitly unlimited cURL timeout can keep workers occupied indefinitely. Set a finite limit when the application's timeout policy requires one. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

CurlHeaderCallbackMissingByteCount.summary: Identify HEADERFUNCTION inline callback with reachable fallthrough or bare return. Explicit integer returns and special libcurl abort values exclude.

CurlHeaderListOverwritten.summary: Setting cURL's HTTP header list again replaces the earlier list. Combine required headers before applying the final configuration. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

CurlHeaderOptionRequiresArray.summary: Identify curl_setopt HTTPHEADER option with a value proven scalar rather than array; curl_setopt_array requires exact option-map extraction.

CurlHeadersIncludedInDecodedBody.summary: Including response headers in a cURL return value makes the combined data unsuitable for JSON decoding. Capture headers separately from the body.

CurlMethodOptionOrderConflict.summary: cURL method options can override previously selected request modes. Configure one consistent final method before executing the transfer.

CurlMultiSuccessAssumedPerTransfer.summary: Successful multi-transfer execution does not establish that each request succeeded. Inspect the completion result for every added transfer.

CurlMultipartBodyWithJsonContentType.summary: An array supplied as cURL post fields generates multipart content. Encode the body explicitly before declaring it to be JSON.

CurlReadCallbackExceedsRequestedSize.summary: Identify READFUNCTION callback whose every reachable nonempty return has length provably greater than its third parameter. Restrict initial analysis to str_repeat of one byte and requested size plus positive integer; exclude error/pause sentinels.

CurlRedirectForwardsCredentials.summary: Unrestricted authentication can forward credentials across redirected hosts. Keep credential forwarding within an explicit trusted redirect policy. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

CurlResponseBodyWithoutReturnTransfer.summary: Detect curl_exec result used as a string or JSON document when a locally created handle is proven never configured with CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER true.
CurlResponseBodyWithoutReturnTransfer.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

CurlResponseZeroRejected.summary: Identify curl_exec result used in a truthiness-based failure branch when the same handle has RETURNTRANSFER proven true, and failure branch throws or returns false. Unknown response still merits this contract warning.

CurlSslServerSpoofing.summary:
Turning off cURL's TLS peer or host-name verification
(`CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER`, `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST`) lets anyone in the
middle impersonate the server. Report places where these options are set to a
disabling value.

CurlTransportSuccessAsHttpSuccess.summary: Detect curl_exec success used as the sole condition for a literal successful return when no HTTP response-code validation occurs for that handle.
CurlTransportSuccessAsHttpSuccess.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

CurlUploadDeclaredSizeMismatch.summary: Identify INFILESIZE set to a known nonnegative integer different from exact remaining bytes of the same handle assigned to INFILE, with UPLOAD true and a locally known data:// read source. Unknown size or cursor excludes.

CurlWholeUrlEscapedAsComponent.summary: Identify CURLOPT_URL receiving direct or unchanged curl_escape output whose original constant argument contains an absolute URL scheme and authority. Partial-component assembly excludes.

CurlWriteCallbackMissingByteCount.summary: A cURL write callback must return the number of bytes it handled. Return the handled count on every successful callback path.

DateIntervalSpecification.summary:
`new DateInterval($spec)` throws for a malformed ISO-8601 duration string.
Check literal specifications against the accepted shapes so the mistake is
caught before runtime.

DateLastErrorsFalseUnchecked.summary: Detect direct array access on getLastErrors result or a proven alias without excluding false on PHP 8.2+.
DateLastErrorsFalseUnchecked.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

DateMinutesMonthTokenConfusion.summary: Detect a date format literal with unescaped hour token H, G, h or g followed by colon and m and optionally seconds.
DateMinutesMonthTokenConfusion.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

DateOnlyParseRetainsCurrentTime.summary: Detect DateTime or DateTimeImmutable createFromFormat with a format containing calendar-date tokens but no time tokens or reset modifiers.
DateOnlyParseRetainsCurrentTime.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

DateParseNormalizationUnchecked.summary: Detect createFromFormat on a literal calendar date whose fields require normalization or whose parsing diagnostics are not checked before accepting the parsed value.
DateParseNormalizationUnchecked.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

DateTimeConstantsUsage.summary:
The `ISO8601` date format constants do not actually produce ISO-8601 output
(the offset lacks a colon). The `ATOM` variants produce the compliant format
and should be used instead.

DateTimeSetTimeUsage.summary:
The microseconds argument of `DateTime::setTime()` / `date_time_set()` only
exists since PHP 7.1. On older versions passing it makes the call fail and
return `false`, so the extra argument is a bug when targeting PHP < 7.1.

DateUsage.summary:
`date()` already formats the current moment when its timestamp argument is
omitted, so passing `time()` explicitly is redundant noise (and costs an extra
call). Drop the second argument.

DecryptionFailureUsedAsPlaintext.summary: Decryption can fail and return false. Check success before treating the result as plaintext.

DeflateStreamNeverFinished.summary: Finish the compressed stream before publishing it. This opt-in rule applies the policy described in Detection.

DegradedSwitch.summary:
A `switch` with only a `default` branch, or with a single `case` (optionally
plus `default`), is just an `if` / `if-else` (or plain code) in disguise and
reads better rewritten that way.

DeprecatedIniOptions.summary:
Reading, changing or restoring an ini directive that the targeted PHP version
has deprecated or removed is either a no-op or a future breakage. Point out
such directives, naming the version and the replacement when there is one.

DetachedSignaturePassedToCombinedVerifie.summary: Identify sodium_crypto_sign_open whose signed-message argument is unchanged result of sodium_crypto_sign_detached; no concatenation may intervene.

DirectoryConstantCanBeUsed.summary:
`dirname(__FILE__)` computes at runtime what the magic constant `__DIR__`
(PHP 5.3+) already provides. Use the constant.

DirectoryIteratorDotEntries.summary: Detect a filesystem mutation on DirectoryIterator entry paths inside foreach without a dominating isDot exclusion.
DirectoryIteratorDotEntries.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

DisallowWritingIntoStaticProperties.summary:
Static properties are global mutable state. This opt-in rule flags assignments
to static properties: by default only writes performed outside the class that
declares the property; optionally every write.
DisallowWritingIntoStaticProperties.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| ALLOW_WRITE_FROM_SOURCE_CLASS | bool | true | true: only writes from outside the declaring class are reported (D3). false: every static property assignment is reported (D2). |

DisconnectedForeachInstruction.summary:
A statement inside a `foreach` body that uses no loop variable and nothing the
loop body changes produces the same effect on every iteration; it most likely
belongs before or after the loop. Optionally (off by default) the rule also
points at objects instantiated on every iteration that could be built once and
cloned.
DisconnectedForeachInstruction.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| SUGGEST_USING_CLONE | bool | false | Enables D13 (object creation on every iteration). The upstream test suite runs with it enabled. |

DomAppendMovesNodeUnexpectedly.summary: Clone the node when preserving its existing parent. This inspection is disabled by default; enabling it selects the stated policy.
DomAppendMovesNodeUnexpectedly.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

DomCrossDocumentAppend.summary: Import the node into the destination document.
DomCrossDocumentAppend.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

DomElementValueContainsBareAmpersand.summary: Append a text node for literal ampersand text.
DomElementValueContainsBareAmpersand.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

DomLiveNodeListRemovalSkipsNodes.summary: Remove live DOM matches without skipping shifted nodes.
DomLiveNodeListRemovalSkipsNodes.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

DomMissingAttributeCheckedAsNull.summary: Use hasAttribute to test whether an attribute exists.
DomMissingAttributeCheckedAsNull.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

DomShallowImportDropsDescendants.summary: Import descendants when copying an element subtree. This inspection is disabled by default; enabling it selects the stated policy.
DomShallowImportDropsDescendants.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

DomTextAssignmentDestroysChildren.summary: Preserve child nodes when adding element text. This inspection is disabled by default; enabling it selects the stated policy.
DomTextAssignmentDestroysChildren.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

DstUnsafeCalendarDayArithmetic.summary: Detect addition of literal 86400 to a timestamp derived from local midnight in a resolved DST-observing timezone under a daily-calendar scheduling contract.
DstUnsafeCalendarDayArithmetic.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

DuplicateArrayKeys.summary:
In an array literal a repeated string key silently overwrites the earlier
entry. Either the earlier entry is dead (different value) or the whole entry
is a redundant copy (same value).

DuplicateMatchCondition.summary: Detect a later match arm condition statically strictly identical to an earlier condition, including resolved references to the same enum case.
DuplicateMatchCondition.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

DynamicCallsToScopeIntrospection.summary:
Since PHP 7.1, functions that read or write the caller's local scope
(`compact`, `extract`, `func_get_args`, …) refuse to run when invoked
indirectly — through a variable holding their name or as a callback string.
Such calls only produce a warning and do nothing useful.

DynamicCorsOriginWithoutVary.summary: A cacheable response whose CORS origin varies by request needs Vary: Origin. Include the variation so shared caches distinguish those responses. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

DynamicInvocationViaScopeResolution.summary:
Calling an instance (non-static) method through `::` (`self::run()`,
`static::run()`, `$obj::run()`) hides that the call is really an instance call
and breaks in static contexts. Such calls should use `->`.

EfferentObjectCoupling.summary:
A class that refers to many distinct other classes depends on too much of the
code base; it is hard to change and to test in isolation. The rule counts the
distinct class names a class mentions and flags it once the count reaches a
limit.
EfferentObjectCoupling.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `optionCouplingLimit` | int | 20 | Minimum number of distinct referenced classes that triggers a report (inclusive). The upstream conformance case runs with `2`. |

ElvisOperatorCanBeUsed.summary:
A full ternary whose "then" branch repeats its condition (`$a ? $a : $b`) can
be written with the short ternary operator `$a ?: $b` (PHP 5.3+), which is
shorter and evaluates the condition once.

EmptyClass.summary:
A named class (or trait, or enum) that declares nothing at all — no
properties, constants, methods, used traits or enum cases — is usually dead
weight or an unfinished stub.

EmptySplCollectionExtraction.summary: Check that the collection contains an element.
EmptySplCollectionExtraction.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

EncodingConversionArgumentsReversed.summary: Converting text away from the output consumer's required encoding can make it invalid input. Convert to the encoding required by the consumer. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

EncryptionInitializationVectorRandomness.summary:
An encryption initialization vector must be unpredictable. When the IV passed
to `openssl_encrypt()` / `mcrypt_encrypt()` can be traced to something other
than a cryptographic random generator (a literal, `mt_rand()`, …), report it.

EnumFromUncheckedExternalValue.summary: Detect a resolved backed enum from call with a request-derived backing value not proven within its declared case set and without handling ValueError.
EnumFromUncheckedExternalValue.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

EnumInstantiation.summary: Use an enum case instead of instantiation.
EnumInstantiation.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

ExceptionConstructedNotThrown.summary: Constructing an exception and discarding it does not interrupt execution. Throw the exception when the failure should stop the operation.

ExecOutputArrayAccumulates.summary: exec appends lines to an existing output array. Reset the array when collecting the independent output of another command. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

ExhaustedGeneratorReused.summary: Detect a resolved Generator identity traversed again after a proven complete iterator_to_array call or complete foreach.
ExhaustedGeneratorReused.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ExitStatusReadWithoutNormalExitCheck.summary: Check normal termination before decoding the exit code.

ExplodeEmptySeparator.summary: Detect explode with a separator statically equal to the empty string.
ExplodeEmptySeparator.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

FailedClosureBindingInvoked.summary: Check closure binding before invoking it.
FailedClosureBindingInvoked.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

FastDigestUsedForPasswordStorage.summary: Detect a password input positively established by an HTML password-field mapping or explicit annotated password parameter reaching md5/sha1/hash and then a persisted credential field.
FastDigestUsedForPasswordStorage.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

FiberResumeBeforeStart.summary: A newly created fiber must be started before it can be resumed. Resume only a suspended fiber.

FiberResumedAfterTermination.summary: Identify resume on a locally allocated Fiber whose inline arrow or closure callback completes with a literal return, without calls, branches, loops, nested callbacks or suspension, and whose start completed on the same unconditional path. Unknown or more complex callbacks do not establish termination.

FiberReturnBeforeTermination.summary: Identify getReturn on a locally allocated Fiber after start of a callback proven to suspend before termination, without a subsequent completion-proving resume.

FiberStartedTwice.summary: Identify a second start on the same locally allocated Fiber after a successful first start on an unconditional straight-line path; no reset or reassignment may intervene.

FiberSuspendOutsideFiber.summary: Identify Fiber::suspend inside the true branch of a strict Fiber::getCurrent() === null guard, with no callback boundary between guard and call.

FileLockFailureUnchecked.summary: Detect a write following flock requiring an exclusive lock where acquisition success is not established.
FileLockFailureUnchecked.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

FilePermissionFailurePassesPolicy.summary: Identify unchecked fileperms result masked with a nonzero permission bitmask, compared equal to zero in a branch returning true or performing the guarded operation. Require direct result provenance.

FileReadFailureUnchecked.summary: Detect file_get_contents or stream_get_contents result consumed as a string without excluding false.
FileReadFailureUnchecked.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

FileStatCacheAfterExternalMutation.summary: Cached file metadata can survive changes made by an external command. Clear the stat cache before reading that metadata again. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

FileTruncatedBeforeLock.summary: Detect fopen in w/w+ variants followed by exclusive flock on the same identity.
FileTruncatedBeforeLock.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

FileWriteResultUnchecked.summary: Detect discarded file_put_contents followed on the same path by a resolved success marker: an unconditional return true or literal success response.
FileWriteResultUnchecked.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

FilteredListJsonShape.summary: Detect builtin json_encode consuming array_filter on a literal sequential array when default filtering certainly removes an interior element and leaves a later numeric key.
FilteredListJsonShape.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

FinallyThrowMasksException.summary: An exception thrown during final cleanup can replace the exception already being propagated. Preserve the original failure when reporting cleanup errors. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

FixedTimeStartWith.summary:
`strpos($s, 'lit') === 0` scans the whole haystack when the prefix is absent,
so its cost grows with the length of `$s`. Comparing only the first N bytes
with `strncmp`/`strncasecmp` answers the same "starts with" question in time
bounded by the needle length.

FopenBinaryUnsafeUsage.summary:
The PHP manual recommends always opening files with the `b` (binary) flag
for portability; the `t` (text translation) flag is Windows-only and
mangles line endings. Also, `b` must come after the access letter (`rb`,
`wb+`, `r+b`) — a leading or middle `b` (`bw`) is wrong.
FopenBinaryUnsafeUsage.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ENFORCE_BINARY_MODIFIER_USAGE` | bool | `true` | When on, modes lacking `b` (with or without `t`) are reported; when off only misplaced `b` is reported. |

ForeachInvariants.summary:
Two loop shapes that are really array iterations in disguise:

1. a counter-based `for` that walks `0 … count($a)` and reads `$a[$i]`;
2. a `while (list($k, $v) = each($a))` loop (`each()` is slow, deprecated in
   PHP 7.2 and removed in PHP 8).
Both are clearer (and faster) as `foreach`.

ForeachReferenceSurvivesLoop.summary: A by-reference foreach leaves its value variable attached to the last array element. Unset that reference before reusing the variable.

ForgottenDebugOutput.summary:
Dumping, tracing and profiler helpers (`var_dump()`, `print_r()`,
framework dumpers, Xdebug functions, …) are typically added while debugging
and forgotten afterwards. Flag their calls unless the context shows the
output is intentional.
ForgottenDebugOutput.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| configuration | list of strings | empty (see below) | Additional debug entries (`function_name` or `\Class::method`). |
| migratedIntoUserSpace | bool | false | When false, the built-in defaults are merged into `configuration`; when true, only `configuration` is used. |

Upstream persists the merged list into `configuration` once and flips
`migratedIntoUserSpace` to true; custos only needs the "effective list"
semantics above.

ForkChildFallsIntoParentWork.summary: Terminate or separate the fork child branch. This opt-in rule applies the policy described in Detection.

FormEncodingUsedForRfc3986Signature.summary: Form-style query encoding differs from RFC3986 encoding for spaces. Select RFC3986 encoding when the configured signature protocol requires it. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.
FormEncodingUsedForRfc3986Signature.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| signatureFunctions | list | `[]` | Configure the explicit policy evidence described in D1. |

FractionalArrayKeyTruncation.summary: PHP converts float array keys to integers and loses their fractional part. Use a string key when the complete value identifies the entry.

FractionalModuloOperand.summary: Identify modulo when either operand is a proven finite fractional numeric value with a nonzero fractional part. Integral floats and unknown numeric strings are excluded.

FtpPendingTransferAcceptedAsComplete.summary: Identify boolean test of ftp_nb_get/put/fget/fput/continue in a branch returning true or emitting constant completion text. Require literal complete output or explicit success return; variable names cannot establish intent.

GdAlphaOutsideSupportedRange.summary: Identify imagecolorallocatealpha or imagecolorclosestalpha with known integer alpha below zero or above127.

GdColorZeroRejectedAsFailure.summary: Identify imagecolorallocate or imagecolorallocatealpha result negated or loosely equal false in a failure branch throwing or returning false; zero is a valid color identifier.

GdImageDimensionsNotPositive.summary: Identify imagecreate or imagecreatetruecolor whose width or height is a known integer at most zero.

GdJpegQualityOutsideSupportedRange.summary: Identify imagejpeg quality argument known integer outside -1 through100; retain -1 default sentinel.

GdPaletteIndexDecodedAsRgb.summary: Identify a color id from imagecolorallocate on a proven imagecreate palette image used in packed RGB extraction with rightshift8/16 and mask255. imagecreatetruecolor, imagepalettetotruecolor and imagecolorsforindex exclude.

GdPngCompressionOutsideSupportedRange.summary: Identify imagepng quality argument known integer outside -1 through9; -1 is the supported default sentinel.

GdTransformationResultIgnored.summary: Identify discarded imagescale or imagecrop return followed by an image encoder receiving same unchanged source image in straight-line scope. Standalone discard and unknown consumers exclude.

GeneratorCallNeverConsumed.summary: Detect a standalone discarded call to a resolved project callable containing yield and at least one deferred side-effect operation.
GeneratorCallNeverConsumed.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

GeneratorReturnBeforeCompletion.summary: A generator exposes its return value only after it finishes. Complete iteration before calling getReturn.

GeneratorRewindAfterAdvance.summary: Identify rewind on a locally created generator proven to have advanced beyond its initial yield using next or send. Require a known generator body with at least two reachable yields.

GetClassUsage.summary:
Since PHP 7.2, passing `null` to `get_class()` is an error-level misuse (it no
longer silently falls back to the calling class). This rule flags
`get_class(x)` calls whose single argument may be `null` and that are not
preceded by any null check of that same expression in the enclosing function.

GetDebugTypeCanBeUsed.summary:
The hand-rolled idiom "class name for objects, `gettype()` otherwise",
written as a ternary over `is_object()`, is what PHP 8.0's
`get_debug_type()` provides in one call. Suggest the built-in.

GetTypeMissUse.summary:
Comparing the result of `gettype($v)` with a type-name string is a roundabout
(and typo-prone) way of calling the dedicated `is_*()` predicate. The rule
suggests the predicate, and flags strings that `gettype()` can never return.

GlobBraceExpansionMissingFlag.summary: Identify glob with a constant pattern containing an unescaped brace alternative with a comma when known flags omit GLOB_BRACE. Literal brace matching is intentionally configurable by disabling this heuristic.

GlobFailureUnchecked.summary: Detect glob result directly or through a proven alias consumed by foreach or array-only operations without excluding false.
GlobFailureUnchecked.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

GmpAutomaticBaseChangesDecimalInput.summary: Specify decimal base for zero-prefixed GMP input. This inspection is disabled by default; enabling it selects the stated policy.
GmpAutomaticBaseChangesDecimalInput.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

GmpDivisionByKnownZero.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

GmpDivisionPairUsedAsNumber.summary: Select a quotient or remainder before using the GMP result.
GmpDivisionPairUsedAsNumber.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

HardcodedCredentialAtKnownSink.summary: Literal credentials embedded in connection setup are difficult to rotate and protect. Load them from the application's external configuration. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.
HardcodedCredentialAtKnownSink.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| excludedPaths | list | `["**/testdata/**", "**/tests/**"]` | Configure the explicit policy evidence described in D1. |

HashContextUsedAfterFinalization.summary: Identify hash_update, hash_copy or hash_final on the same local context after unconditional hash_final, with no replacement.

HashFileFailureUsedAsDigest.summary: Identify unchecked hash_file result consumed as file contents or as an expected digest in strict comparison; exclude result propagation and guarded false rejection.

HeadersAfterCommittedOutput.summary: Detect header or setcookie after demonstrably committed output on every incoming path, such as output plus flush with no active buffering.
HeadersAfterCommittedOutput.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

HeapIterationConsumesCollection.summary: Iterate a clone to preserve the heap. This opt-in inspection applies the policy stated in Detection.
HeapIterationConsumesCollection.options: None. Enabling the rule declares the policy stated in Detection; the rule is disabled by default.

HexDecodeOddLengthLiteral.summary: Hexadecimal decoding requires complete pairs of digits. Supply an even number of hexadecimal characters.

HostCookiePrefixContractViolation.summary: A __Host- cookie requires Secure, path /, and no Domain attribute. Set those attributes together so browsers accept the intended cookie.

HostnameSubstitution.summary:
`$_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']` and `$_SERVER['SERVER_NAME']` can be controlled by the
client (Host header). Using them to build e-mail addresses or storing them in
domain/host/email-like variables or properties without a whitelist check lets
an attacker inject their own domain.

HttpErrorBodyReadWithoutIgnoreErrors.summary: Enable reading HTTP error response bodies. This opt-in inspection applies the policy stated in Detection.
HttpErrorBodyReadWithoutIgnoreErrors.options: None. Enabling the rule declares the policy stated in Detection; the rule is disabled by default.

IfReturnReturnSimplification.summary:
An `if` whose only job is to return `true` in one branch and `false` in the
other is a long-winded way of returning the condition itself (or its
negation). Return the expression directly.

ImageDecodeFailureUnchecked.summary: Decoding image bytes can fail and return false. Check the result before using it as an image.

ImageEncoderContentTypeMismatch.summary: The response content type must describe the image bytes being written. Match it to the selected image encoder.

ImagickFrameIndexPastEnd.summary: Identify resolved Imagick::setIteratorIndex whose argument is same unchanged receiver getNumberImages result, or a constant index proven at least known positive frame count. Negative indices may have documented special meaning and are excluded.

ImagickResizeStatusUsedAsImage.summary: Identify method/property access on unchanged result of resolved Imagick::resizeImage; it returns a boolean, not a replacement image.

ImagickSingleBlobDropsRequiredFrames.summary: Identify Imagick::getImageBlob only with preserveFrames true and local provenance proving at least two image frames, such as two successful newImage/addImage operations. Filename extensions and comments cannot establish frame count. getImagesBlob and known single-frame images exclude.
ImagickSingleBlobDropsRequiredFrames.options: `preserveFrames`: bool, default `false`. Only report when explicitly enabled and local provenance proves at least two loaded image frames. Frame names or comments do not establish this policy.

ImmutableDateResultIgnored.summary: Detect discarded return from modify, add, sub, setDate, setTime, setTimestamp or setTimezone on a receiver proven DateTimeImmutable.
ImmutableDateResultIgnored.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

ImplodeArgumentsOrder.summary:
`implode()` historically accepted its separator in either position; passing the
pieces first and the separator second is deprecated (7.4) and removed (8.0).
When the second argument is clearly the separator (a string literal), the
arguments are swapped.

InArrayMissUse.summary:
Two wasteful `in_array()` shapes:

- searching the keys list built by `array_keys($a)` — a direct key lookup
  (`array_key_exists`) avoids building the list;
- searching a one-element array literal — that is just a comparison with the
  single element.
InArrayMissUse.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FORCE_STRICT_COMPARISON` | bool | `false` | When on, pattern C always produces `===`/`!==`, whatever the 3rd argument. The EA fixture runs with it off. |

Comparison style (`regular`/`yoda`) is the global setting.

IncorrectRandomRange.summary:
`rand()`, `mt_rand()` and `random_int()` expect `(min, max)`. Passing a
minimum greater than the maximum is an error (`random_int()` throws,
`mt_rand()` warns/returns false on older versions, `rand()` silently swaps).
Flag calls whose bounds are known numbers in the wrong order.

IncrementDecrementOperationEquivalent.summary:
Adding or subtracting the literal `1` to a variable and storing it back
(`$n += 1`, `$n = $n - 1`, …) is more idiomatically written with the increment
or decrement operator.
IncrementDecrementOperationEquivalent.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| PREFER_PREFIX_STYLE | bool | true | Fix produces `++$x` / `--$x`. |
| PREFER_SUFFIX_STYLE | bool | false | Mutually exclusive with the above (radio choice); fix produces `$x++` / `$x--` whenever `PREFER_PREFIX_STYLE` is false. |

IncrementalInflateEncodingMismatch.summary: Match the inflate encoding to the input.

InfinityLoop.summary:
A method whose only statement calls the very same method on `$this`,
`self` or `static` recurses unconditionally until the stack overflows —
typically a getter/proxy that was meant to call a property, a parent method
or a differently named method.

InstanceofCanBeUsed.summary:
Testing an object's class through string comparisons or reflection-like
helpers (`get_class($o) === 'Foo'`, `is_a($o, 'Foo')`,
`in_array('Foo', class_parents($o))`, …) is slower and less readable than the
`instanceof` operator, and hides the class name from refactoring tools.
Suggest `instanceof` when the subject is known to be a non-string value and
the named class exists.

IntdivMinimumIntegerOverflow.summary: Identify intdiv whose dividend resolves to PHP_INT_MIN and divisor to -1; do not assume a particular machine integer width.

IntdivZeroDivisor.summary: Identify intdiv with second operand proven integer zero.

IntegerCastOutOfRangeLiteral.summary: An integer string outside the supported integer range cannot be preserved by an integer cast. Keep it as a string or use arbitrary precision.

InterfaceInstantiation.summary: Identify new expressions whose statically resolved declaration is an interface, including class-string literals resolved to that declaration.

IntervalDayComponentAsTotal.summary: Detect a DateInterval produced by diff whose format consists solely of %d when the opt-in contract requires total elapsed days.
IntervalDayComponentAsTotal.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

IntlFormattingFailureUnchecked.summary: Internationalization formatting can fail and return false. Check success before consuming the formatted string.

IntlGregorianMonthOffByOne.summary: Use zero-based Gregorian month numbers. This opt-in rule applies the policy described in Detection.

InverseTrigInvalidRealDomain.summary: Keep the inverse trigonometric argument within minus one and one.
InverseTrigInvalidRealDomain.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

InvertedIfElseConstructs.summary:
An `if`/`else` whose condition is a negation (`!expr`, or `false === expr`)
reads backwards: swapping the two branches and dropping the negation makes the
main path positive and easier to follow.

IsCountableCanBeUsed.summary:
`is_array($v) || $v instanceof Countable` is exactly what `is_countable($v)`
checks. On a language level where `is_countable()` is available, the one call
is shorter and makes the intent obvious.

IsEmptyFunctionUsage.summary:
`empty()` treats many unrelated values (`0`, `'0'`, `''`, `[]`, `null`,
`false`) as "empty". When the argument's type is known, a precise check is
clearer: `count(...) === 0` for countables, `... === null` for nullable
scalars/objects. Optionally, any other `empty()` use can be flagged.
IsEmptyFunctionUsage.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| REPORT_EMPTY_USAGE | bool | false | Enables the generic report D3. |
| SUGGEST_TO_USE_COUNT_CHECK | bool | false | Enables D1 (count comparison for arrays/Countable). |
| SUGGEST_TO_USE_NULL_COMPARISON | bool | true | Enables D2 (null comparison) as a whole. |
| SUGGEST_NULL_COMPARISON_FOR_SCALARS | bool | true | Enables D2a (nullable int/float/bool/resource); D2b (objects) only needs the previous option. |

Global setting: comparison style (`regular` default / `yoda`) selects the
operand order of F1/F2.

IsIterableCanBeUsed.summary:
`is_array($v) || $v instanceof Traversable` is exactly what `is_iterable($v)`
checks. On a language level where `is_iterable()` is available, the one call
is shorter and makes the intent obvious.

IsNullFunctionUsage.summary:
`is_null($v)` is a function call doing what the `=== null` comparison does
natively. This opt-in rule rewrites `is_null()` calls (including negations and
comparisons of the result against `true`/`false`) into an identity comparison
with `null`.
IsNullFunctionUsage.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| (none) | | | Operand order follows the global comparison style (`regular` default / `yoda`). |

IsoWeekCalendarYearMismatch.summary: Detect a date format literal containing unescaped Y and W in the same year-week label.
IsoWeekCalendarYearMismatch.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

IssetArgumentExistence.summary:
`isset($v)`, `empty($v)` and `$v ?? …` silently accept a variable that is
never defined in the current function. When the first mention of a plain
variable inside a function body is such an existence check, the variable can
never be set at that point — usually a typo or a leftover after a refactoring.
IssetArgumentExistence.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IGNORE_INCLUDES` | bool | `true` | When `true`, include/require statements in the function are disregarded (reports still happen). When `false`, a function containing any include/require is skipped entirely (the included file could define the variable). The EA fixture runs with `false`. |

IssetConstructsCanBeMerged.summary:
`isset()` accepts several arguments and is true only when all of them are set.
A chain such as `isset($p) && isset($q)` is therefore the same as
`isset($p, $q)`, and `!isset($p) || !isset($q)` the same as `!isset($p, $q)`.
Merging keeps conditions short.

IteratorCountChangesRequiredPosition.summary: Identify a position-dependent current or key read on a locally allocated finite ArrayIterator after iterator_count consumes it, without rewind or seek. Unknown iterator implementations are excluded.

IteratorMaterializationKeyCollision.summary: Detect iterator_to_array with key preservation enabled/default on a resolved generator yielding two certainly equal keys on the same execution path.
IteratorMaterializationKeyCollision.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

JsonDecodeKnownInvalidUtf8.summary: Identify json_decode with constant invalid UTF-8 bytes unless flags include JSON_INVALID_UTF8_IGNORE or JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE; validation uses actual string bytes.

JsonEncodeFlagPassedToDecode.summary: JSON encoding flags do not describe the intended decoding policy. Use the constants supported by json_decode.

JsonEncodeKnownRecursiveValue.summary: Identify json_encode of a local array whose reference assignments prove a cycle reachable from encoded root. JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR explicitly permits replacement and excludes.

JsonEncodeNonFiniteNumber.summary: Identify json_encode with proven NAN, INF or -INF reachable in a known value tree, unless JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR explicitly permits replacement.

JsonEncodingApiUsage.summary:
`json_decode()` without its second argument silently returns `stdClass`
objects, which readers often confuse with arrays; and both `json_decode()` and
`json_encode()` report failures only through `json_last_error()` unless the
`JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR` flag (PHP 7.3+) is passed. This rule asks for an explicit
decoding target and for exception-based error handling.
JsonEncodingApiUsage.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| HARDEN_DECODING_RESULT_TYPE | bool | true | Enables kind T (D1). Also affects `<assoc>` in F2. |
| DECODE_AS_ARRAY | bool | false | Fixes insert `true` (decode to arrays) instead of `false`. |
| DECODE_AS_OBJECT | bool | true | Radio-button companion of DECODE_AS_ARRAY; has no effect on detection or fixes by itself. |
| HARDEN_ERRORS_HANDLING | bool | true | Enables kind E (D2–D5). |

Upstream fixture configurations: (a) T only — HARDEN_DECODING_RESULT_TYPE on,
DECODE_AS_ARRAY on, HARDEN_ERRORS_HANDLING off, default PHP level;
(b) E only — HARDEN_DECODING_RESULT_TYPE off, HARDEN_ERRORS_HANDLING on, PHP 7.3.

JsonForceObjectChangesNestedLists.summary: JSON_FORCE_OBJECT changes nested lists into objects as well as the outer structure. Convert only the specific map that needs object representation. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

JsonIntegerPrecisionLoss.summary: Detect json_decode on literal JSON containing an integer outside the portable signed 64-bit range without JSON_BIGINT_AS_STRING.
JsonIntegerPrecisionLoss.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

JsonInvalidDepth.summary: Identify json_decode or json_encode with known integer depth at most zero. Additionally report json_decode depth above 2147483647; do not assume the decoder upper bound applies to json_encode.

JsonNumericCheckChangesIdentifiers.summary: Numeric JSON conversion can remove leading zeros or a leading plus sign from identifier strings. Keep those values as strings when their formatting matters. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

JsonPartialOutputOverridesThrow.summary: Partial JSON output takes precedence over throwing on encoding errors. Choose the error policy the caller actually expects.

LibxmlErrorBufferNeverCleared.summary: Repeated XML parsing can accumulate internally collected errors. Retrieve and clear the error buffer during the parsing loop. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

LinkedListDeleteIterationUnexpected.summary: Preserve linked-list elements during iteration. This opt-in inspection applies the policy stated in Detection.
LinkedListDeleteIterationUnexpected.options: None. Enabling the rule declares the policy stated in Detection; the rule is disabled by default.

LocalizedNumberTrailingInputAccepted.summary: Reject unparsed number suffixes. This opt-in rule applies the policy described in Detection.

LogarithmInvalidRealDomain.options: None. Use normal rule configuration to enable or disable the inspection.

LongInheritanceChain.summary:
Deep `extends` chains spread behaviour over many levels and make a class hard
to understand. The rule counts the ancestors of a class and complains when the
chain reaches a threshold, with carve-outs for exception hierarchies, test
cases and well-known framework base classes.
LongInheritanceChain.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMPLAIN_THRESHOLD` | int | 3 | Minimum ancestor count (inclusive) that triggers a report. |

LoopClosureCapturesReference.summary: Deferred closures that capture a loop counter by reference observe its later value. Capture by value when each callback needs its own iteration value. This inspection is disabled by default because the intended policy or use can vary.

LoopWhichDoesNotLoop.summary:
A loop whose body always leaves on the first pass (its last statement is
`break`, `return` or `throw` and nothing continues it), or whose body is
empty, never actually iterates. It is either a bug or a disguised `if` /
"take first element" idiom.

MagicMethodsValidity.summary:
PHP's magic methods (`__get`, `__toString`, `__clone`, …) have fixed contracts:
static-ness, visibility, number of parameters, return value. Violations are
fatal errors, silently ignored methods or subtle bugs. This rule validates
each magic method declared in a class-like, flags `__`-prefixed methods that
are not magic, and catches magic names typed with a single underscore.

MillisecondsUsedAsUnixSeconds.summary: Detect date, gmdate or DateTime setTimestamp consuming a positive literal timestamp between 100000000000 and 9999999999999 under an explicit millisecond-input contract.
MillisecondsUsedAsUnixSeconds.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

MisorderedModifiers.summary:
PSR-1/PSR-12 style expects method modifiers in a fixed order: `final` /
`abstract` first, then the visibility, then `static`. Methods whose modifiers
are written in another order are flagged and re-sorted.

MissUsingParentKeyword.summary:
`parent::m()` is meant for calling the overridden implementation of the
current method. When it calls some *other* inherited method that nobody in the
hierarchy overrides, it is equivalent to `$this->m()` / `self::m()`, and using
`parent::` there only misleads readers (and silently bypasses future
overrides).

MissingArrayInitialization.summary:
Appending to a local array (`$list[] = …`) deep inside nested loops without
ever initialising it means the variable is undefined (`null`) when nothing is
appended, and its contents leak between outer iterations if it is meant to be
reset. The array should be initialised explicitly at the right place.

MissingIssetImplementation.summary:
`isset($obj->name)` / `empty($obj->name)` on a property the class does not
declare can only answer correctly if the class implements `__isset()`. When it
does not (typically classes with `__get` only), the check is always
false/empty, which is a silent logic bug.

MissingOrEmptyGroupStatement.summary:
Control structures should always use a braced block for their body. A body
written as a bare statement is easy to break when a second line is added; a
braced block that contains nothing is usually leftover or unfinished code.
MissingOrEmptyGroupStatement.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| REPORT_EMPTY_BODY | bool | true | Enables D2 (empty braced bodies). D1 is always on. |

MkdirRaceCondition.summary:
`mkdir()` fails when the directory already exists — including when another
process created it a moment after our own `is_dir()` check. A failed
`mkdir()` must therefore be followed by an `is_dir()` re-check before being
treated as an error, and its result must not be ignored.

MktimeUsage.summary:
Two legacy `mktime()` / `gmmktime()` usages:
calling them without arguments just returns the current timestamp (and
emits an `E_STRICT`/deprecation notice on PHP 5.x/7.x) — `time()` is the
intended call; and the seventh `$is_dst` argument was deprecated in PHP 5.1
and removed in PHP 7.0.

MockingMethodsCorrectness.summary:
Two classes of PHPUnit mock-configuration mistakes inside tests:
passing a stub *object* (`$this->returnValue(...)`, `$this->returnCallback(...)`)
to `willReturn()` — which then returns the stub object itself instead of
running it — and configuring (`->method('name')`) a method that the mocked
class does not have, or that is `final` and therefore cannot be overridden by
the generated double.

MonthAdditionDateOverflow.summary: Detect modify with literal +1 month or -1 month on a resolved literal date when the target month cannot contain the original day number.
MonthAdditionDateOverflow.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

MultiAssignmentUsage.summary:
Two patterns where destructuring would be clearer:

1. unpacking the `foreach` value variable with `list(...) = $value` as a
   separate statement, when `foreach (... as list(...))` can do it directly
   (PHP 5.5+);
2. consecutive statements pulling numbered elements out of the same array
   one at a time (`$a = $row[0]; $b = $row[1];`), which a single
   `list(...) = $row` replaces.

MultibytePositionUsedAsByteOffset.summary: Multibyte character positions are not byte offsets. Use matching multibyte operations when slicing at a multibyte search result.

MultipleReturnStatements.summary:
A method with many exit points is harder to follow than one with a single
result path. The rule counts `return` statements per method and reports it
above two configurable thresholds (a normal one and a severe one).
MultipleReturnStatements.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMPLAIN_THRESHOLD` | int | 3 | Return count (inclusive) from which a warning is raised. |
| `SCREAM_THRESHOLD` | int | 5 | Return count (inclusive) from which an error is raised instead. |

MysqlDdlImplicitlyCommitsTransaction.summary: Some MySQL DDL statements implicitly commit an active transaction. Keep them outside operations that depend on rolling back the transaction.

MysqliBindingTypeCountMismatch.summary: The mysqli binding type string must have one character per bound variable. Match its length to the supplied arguments.

MysqliBoundArrayReassigned.summary: mysqli parameter bindings retain references to the originally bound array elements. Update those elements rather than replacing the whole array.

MysqliEscapedValueSurvivesCharsetChange.summary: Identify query SQL containing unchanged real_escape_string output after set_charset on same mysqli connection to a proven different charset. Require known charset before escaping and successful charset change; unknown changes exclude.

MysqliInvalidBindingType.summary: mysqli bindings accept only the supported integer, floating-point, string and blob type letters. Correct unsupported characters in the type string.

MysqliMultiQueryResultsNotDrained.summary: Identify query on same resolved mysqli after successful multi_query containing at least two known statements, before a complete more_results/next_result drain loop. Unknown calls invalidate proof; first result alone does not drain subsequent results.

MysqliPlaceholderBindingMismatch.summary: Every SQL parameter placeholder needs a corresponding bound value. Match the binding argument count to the prepared statement.

MysqliUnbufferedResultBlocksNextQuery.summary: An unbuffered mysqli result can block further queries on the same connection. Consume or free it before issuing another query.

NanCheckedWithEquality.summary: NaN does not equal itself, so equality comparisons cannot recognize it. Use is_nan when testing whether a numeric value is NaN.

NegativeBitShiftCount.summary: Identify left or right shift whose shift count is a proven negative integer.

NestedAssignmentsUsage.summary:
Chained assignments such as `$x = $y = 5` pack several writes into one
expression; they are easy to misread and a typo (`=` instead of `+`/`==`)
silently becomes another assignment. Separate statements are clearer.

NestedNotOperators.summary:
Stacking logical-not operators (`!!$x`, `!!!$x`) is a cryptic way to write a
boolean cast or a single negation. An even number of `!` is a `(bool)` cast, an
odd number is one `!`.

NestedPdoTransactionWithoutSavepoint.summary: PDO does not start nested transactions by calling beginTransaction again. Finish the current transaction or use an appropriate savepoint abstraction.

NestedPositiveIfStatements.summary:
An `if` that is the only statement inside another `if` (without alternative
branches) can be merged into its parent with `&&`; an `if` that is the only
statement inside an `else` block can become `else if`. Both remove a nesting
level.

NestedTernaryOperator.summary:
A ternary inside another ternary is hard to read and, without parentheses,
its associativity is a classic PHP trap. Chains of short ternaries
(`$a ?: $b ?: $c`) read naturally and are accepted.

NeverFunctionFallsThrough.summary: Terminate every path in the never function.
NeverFunctionFallsThrough.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

NoContentResponseWithBody.summary: Detect nonempty output after response status is proven 204 and before any status change.
NoContentResponseWithBody.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

NonBlockingEmptyReadTreatedAsEof.summary: An empty nonblocking read can mean that no data is currently available. Check EOF separately before closing the stream.

NonExhaustiveEnumMatch.summary: Detect match over a resolved enum when reachable enum cases are missing and there is no default arm.
NonExhaustiveEnumMatch.options: None. Enable or disable this rule through normal rule configuration.

NonRepeatableAttributeRepeated.options: None. Use ordinary rule configuration to enable or disable this inspection.

NonSecureParseStrUsage.summary:
Called with a single argument, `parse_str()` / `mb_parse_str()` create
variables in the current scope from user-supplied query strings, which can
overwrite existing variables. Always pass the result array as second
argument.

NonSecureUniqidUsage.summary:
Without its `more_entropy` argument, `uniqid()` is based only on the current
time in microseconds and collides easily. Pass `true` as second argument,
also when `uniqid` is used as a callback.

NonVoidFunctionFallsThrough.summary: Identify the return type of an explicitly nonvoid nongenerator function when structural control flow proves a reachable normal exit without return or throw. Exclude mixed, void, never and untyped returns; a bare return is covered separately. Restrict proof to finite straight-line blocks and if/else branches; loops, switch, try, goto, parser recovery and all calls on a candidate exit path exclude because they may terminate, throw or exit.

NonblockingSocketConnectPendingRejected.summary: Identify negated socket_connect failure branch throwing or returning false when socket_set_nonblock succeeded or unconditionally preceded it on same socket and branch contains no socket_last_error inspection. A checked nonblocking setup is preferred but unknown setup alone cannot prove state.

NonblockingWaitZeroTreatedAsReaped.summary: Require a positive PID from nonblocking wait.

NotOptimalIfConditions.summary:
Looks at the conditions of `if`/`elseif` statements and flags four kinds of
problems: a cheap operand evaluated after an expensive one in an `&&`/`||`
chain (short-circuiting would save work if swapped), `and`/`or` keyword
operators (low precedence, error-prone), an equality comparison on a value
that the same `&&` chain also tests with `instanceof` (likely a logic bug),
and an `instanceof` check made redundant by another `instanceof` on the same
subject against a related type.
NotOptimalIfConditions.options:
| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|--------|------|---------|--------|
| REPORT_LITERAL_OPERATORS | bool | true | enables D2 |
| REPORT_INSTANCE_OF_FLAWS | bool | true | enables D3 and D4 |
| SUGGEST_OPTIMIZING_CONDITIONS | bool | true | enables D1 |

Upstream tests set one option to `true` without disabling the others, so each
fixture is effectively evaluated with all checks on.

NotOptimalRegularExpressions.summary:
A family of checks on PCRE patterns passed to the `preg_*` functions: broken
or missing delimiters, invalid / pointless / missing modifiers, class
